tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Certificate Verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is required on all builds, including development builds; development builds must verify certificates in the same way as every other build, and certificate verification is not skipped in any build configuration.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

The later one (#15) withdrew that and requires verification on all builds. I used only the later entry and left out the retired alternative. Nothing in the repo files records a TLS verification decision, so memory was the only source.

My first attempt to create the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead. I haven't committed anything.
